name: huawei_ads-mcp
display_name: 鲸鸿动能 Petal Ads (Huawei Ads) MCP
description: 鲸鸿动能 Petal Ads (Huawei Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pau

platform_mcp_huawei_ads_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HUAWEI_ADS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_huawei_ads_client_id.description: Your Marketing API client ID (华为开发者联盟 → 申请客户端ID).

platform_mcp_huawei_ads_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HUAWEI_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_huawei_ads_client_secret.description: The client secret shown for that client ID in the developer alliance.

platform_mcp_huawei_ads_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HUAWEI_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_huawei_ads_refresh_token.description: refresh_token from the authorization-code login (authorize with access_type=offline and the ads scopes, then exchange the code at /oauth2/v2/token), see ads_api09.

platform_mcp_huawei_ads_advertiser_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HUAWEI_ADS_ADVERTISER_ID
platform_mcp_huawei_ads_advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID; required when the authorizing Huawei ID is a manager (经理) account, a service-provider account or linked to several sub-client advertisers.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Refreshes the access token and reads the first page of campaigns: verifies the authorization and Marketing API permission.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET openapi/v2/manager/advertiser/query: the advertiser accounts under a manager (经理) account authorization (page_size 10–50). Advertiser ids are 18-digit integers above 2^53: the Python server returns them exactly, the TypeScript server's JSON parser may round the last digits.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET openapi/v2/promotion/campaign/query?advertiser_id&page_num&page_size (the documented query-parameter form; the new /ads/v1/promotion/campaign/query takes a JSON body on GET, which is not sent). page_size must be 10–50. `status` is a show_status value such as CAMPAIGN_STATUS_DELIVERY_OK (【计划界面显示的状态】).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: POST openapi/v2/reports/campaign/query per day and campaign (time_granularity DAILY, group_by CAMPAIGN_ID + DATE), filtered to campaign_id when given: impressions (show_count), clicks, cost (CNY), cpc and download/install/activation counts; up to 1,000 rows. stat_datetime is YYYYMMDDHH. Contract (合约) data is not included.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST /ads/v1/promotion/campaign/update {campaign_id, daily_budget: {daily_budget, daily_budget_op_type: UPDATE_TODAY_DAILY_BUDGET}}: today's campaign daily limit, a whole number of CNY that must differ from the current value (see 修改限额约束). `currency` is not applied.
